upstream_readme: The script does not ship with demo data.

outcome_blup: pheno2-r.txt with inbred and BLUP columns

method_notes: Selects one most significant eQTL SNP per gene from the top-eQTL table.
Fits genotype-expression and genotype-outcome linear models.
Computes a ratio estimate and chi-square P value.
Uses the original paper's 2SLS-style single-instrument workflow, not a multi-SNP LD-aware model.
